verifications.claim: All Publix stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Our stores will be closed on Easter Sunday'; 'Sunday, April 5, is Easter.' R4: 'No, all Publix stores are closed on Easter.' R5: 'Publix will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.' R6: 'No. Publix is never open on Easter Sunday.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state all Publix stores closed on Easter Sunday, specifying April 5, 2026 in relevant contexts.

verifications.claim: Publix closes for only three holidays per year.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Publix stores typically close on three holidays each year.' R2: 'Publix supermarket is closed for three holidays every year.' R5: 'Publix traditionally closes only three times each year.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state Publix closes for exactly three holidays per year.

verifications.claim: Publix closes on Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Easter, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.' R2: 'Easter, Thanksgiving and Christmas.' R5: 'Thanksgiving, Christmas, and Easter.' R6: 'Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day and Easter.'

verifications.evidence: R1: 'Publix stores will be open normal operating hours on Saturday, April 4, the day before Easter Sunday.'
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states normal hours on Saturday before Easter.
